relations.predicate: recovers the integer coefficients produced by
relations.quote: It recovers the integer coefficients produced by the [Reduction of integer product to digit convolution](radix-digit-reduction.md).

symbols.name: working precision
symbols.meaning: The number of fractional bits in each fixed-point numerator, so values are stored over the denominator $2^p$.
symbols.quote: Each complex coefficient is stored as a pair of integer numerators over the denominator $2^p$, where $p$ is the working precision in bits, so a numerator $H$ represents $H/2^p$.

symbols.name: cyclic convolution length
symbols.meaning: The number of coefficients in the cyclic convolution whose transforms are computed.
symbols.quote: The transforms are normalized: the array that comes out is the integer convolution divided by $S^2$, where $S$ is the length of the cyclic convolution.

symbols.name: product coefficient
symbols.meaning: The exact integer coefficient of the product at index $j$.
symbols.quote: Let $c_j$ be the exact integer coefficient of the product at index $j$, for $0\le j<S$.

symbols.name: digit width
symbols.meaning: The number of bits in each radix digit, equal to the ceiling of the base-2 logarithm of the input length $n$.
symbols.quote: Digits have $b$ bits, where $b=\lceil\log_2 n\rceil$ and $n$ is the input length, so the radix is $2^b$.

symbols.name: output digit
symbols.meaning: The radix-$2^b$ digit of the product at position $j$.
symbols.quote: The digit $d_j$ is the output digit at position $j$.

symbols.name: carry
symbols.meaning: The carry from the processed coefficients into position $j$.
symbols.quote: The carry $k_j$ is the carry from the processed coefficients into position $j$.
